name: agent_send
description: Send a message to another agent session. Coordinators address their children by harp (to_agent_id) — delivery completes a waiting agent_recv, starts a new turn on an idle child, queues mid-turn for the next boundary, or resumes an ended session. Delegated children may only address to_role: "parent"; peer messaging routes via the coordinator. Queued delivery is durable (at-least-once): a message to an offline session survives coordinator restarts.

in_reply_to.description: Correlates a reply to an earlier inbound PeerMessage.message_id.

structured.description: Optional structured companion. `kind` names the message kind (e.g. result, question, error)

text.description: Message body (compact: findings, questions, verdicts — bulk detail stays in the session transcript)

to_agent_id.description: Recipient agent id — a child session harp (from spawn's child_agent_id or the roster). Exactly one of to_agent_id / to_role is set

to_role.description: Role address. Delegated children may ONLY send to_role: "parent"; peer traffic routes via the coordinator
